You bring the idea — we put it on a shirt.

We're a little family shop in Cuba City, Wisconsin, and we make custom t-shirts, sweatshirts and hoodies with your design on them — a favorite photo, a drawing, a name, a saying, anything you can dream up. We also sell DTF prints if you'd rather press them yourself.

nice and easy

How ordering works

1

Send us your design

A photo of your kids, your dog, your artwork, your logo — or just the words you want. If you can picture it, we can probably print it.

2

Pick your shirt

Choose the style, color and sizes below and we'll add it all up for you right on the page — no surprises, no guessing.

3

We make it with care

We press your design by hand and let you know as soon as your order is ready. That's it — you just get to enjoy it.

we print, you press

DTF prints — buy the print, press it yourself

Got your own shirts and a heat press? Order just the print. Our DTF (direct-to-film) prints are perfect for DIY projects, small businesses, events and more — you create it, we print it, you press it.

12″ × 12″$3.50per print
10″ × 10″$1.50per print
6″ × 6″$1.00per print
4″ × 3″$0.75per print

…and many sizes in between! If your design lands between these, just pick “another size” in the order form and we'll price it for you.

  • Vibrant colors
  • Long lasting
  • Easy to press
  • Works on many fabrics
  • Great for small business owners

hi, we're so glad you're here

Three family members, one little shop

Intertwined Design is a family affair — Belle, Jennifer and Alethia, three family members who love making things for people, each in her own way. What started as making shirts for the folks we love turned into making them for everybody, and honestly? We wouldn't have it any other way.

And the mushrooms you'll find sprouting all over this page? Those are just us. We think things grow better when they're made with love and a little patience — shirts included. Every order that comes through gets the same care we'd give one of our own, because around here, our customers turn into friends pretty quick.

Thank you for supporting our small business. It truly means the world to us.

BelleJenniferAlethia
